title: Eval-runner paragraph in the pytest-bdd notes
item: Write the eval-runner paragraph in pytest-bdd-skill-notes.md, naming the two axes separately: instrument (gate vs scored run, same step definitions) and lifecycle (@planned → @active capability → regression), citing Adzic ch. 11 and the Anthropic evals article.
motivation: Deck and notes should use the same words (gate / benchmark); the lifecycle markers are what the pytest-bdd skill will implement.
